title: fix(ci): label PRs touching the published docs tree `documentation` (objectui#10012)
body:
Fixes #10012
Clause-②: no — repository CI labelling; no published contract, accept set or public surface

## What changed

- `.github/labeler.yml`: the existing `documentation` rule gains one glob, `'content/**/*'` (the published docs site), with three comment lines above the rule saying why. The diff is additions only (`git diff --numstat` reads `4 0` for this file). Every existing line is byte-identical, including the trailing space after the rule's `any-glob-to-any-file:` key.
- `scripts/__tests__/labeler-package-coverage.test.ts`: one new `it`, "labels a change to the published docs tree `documentation`". It asserts that the probe path `content/docs/guide/labeler-coverage-probe.mdx` draws `documentation`. `23 0` in numstat.
- No new workflow, script or gate. No workflow file touched.

## Premise, re-measured on base `06a96e9480`

- `git grep -n "content/" HEAD -- .github/labeler.yml` on the base: 0 hits (exit 1). Control: `git grep -n "docs/"` on the same file finds 1 hit (exit 0).
- `.github/workflows/labeler.yml` still runs `actions/labeler@v7` with `sync-labels: true`.
- `content/` holds 203 tracked files, all under `content/docs` (144 `.mdx`, 40 `.md`, 19 `.json`). `docs/` holds 25. `'content/**/*'` covers every file type in the tree, not just markdown. These counts come from a one-time `git ls-tree -r` read on the base, and nothing re-derives them.

## Why `documentation`, and why the assertion names it

- Label registry read with `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/labels` (98 labels, one page). `documentation` exists and no other docs label does, so this PR adds no label.
- No gate or seat tool reads `documentation` as a verdict. A grep across objectui `.github`, `scripts` and `.claude`, plus objectstack `scripts/pm`, `.claude` and `.github`, finds it only in test fixtures. Its readers are the same as for every path label: people and sweeps filtering the PR list.
- objectstack's own `.github/labeler.yml` already lists `'content/**/*'` under `documentation`. Same label, same spelling.
- `sync-labels: true`: the `actions/labeler` v7 tag (`bf12e9b0`) has an `else if (syncLabels)` branch in `src/labeler.ts`. That branch removes from the PR's existing labels every configured label whose globs match nothing. So a `documentation` label hung by hand on a content-only PR comes off on the next run unless `documentation` itself matches. For that reason the pin asserts `documentation` rather than "at least one label".

## Ablation (fix committed first, at `3621137ccc`)

`node /home/user/objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file .github/labeler.yml --anchor "      - 'content/**/*'" + newline --delete -- VITEST_RUN`, where VITEST_RUN is the single-file vitest run of the coverage test under the shared verify lock.

- The mutation landed: the anchor count went from 1 to 0 and the blob went from `8b5fa60ee174` to `860e8ef3d35e`. An independent `grep -c` during the run read 0.
- Run result: `Tests  1 failed | 6 passed (7)`. The one failure is the new test: `AssertionError: expected [] to include 'documentation'`. With the glob removed, the base config draws no label at all for a published-docs path, the same empty set the card measured live on objectui#10011. The lit control and every package assertion stayed green.
- Restore: `git checkout HEAD -- ABS_PATH`. Afterwards the file's blob equals the HEAD blob `8b5fa60ee174` and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Verification (all at HEAD `3621137ccc`, clean tree)

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 scripts/__tests__/labeler-package-coverage.test.ts scripts/__tests__/markdown-test-inputs.test.ts scripts/__tests__/ci-cd-pipeline-doc.test.ts` (run under the verify lock): `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 117 passed (117)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. Only the first file reads `.github/labeler.yml`. The second audits every test file's markdown reads, this one included. The third matches a grep for `labeler.yml`.
- `pnpm type-check:scripts`: exit 0. `tsc --listFilesOnly` on that project lists the edited test (1 hit).
- `node scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs --audit`: exit 0, all candidates adjudicated. The probe page deliberately does not exist, so the scanner does not enrol this test as a reader of a real page.
- `pnpm check:control-bytes`: OK, exit 0.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: `0 new citation(s)`, exit 0.
- `pnpm check:test-path-roots`, `check:shell-escape-residue`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers` and `check:vi-mock-override-shape`: all OK, exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0, "no changeset is owed". No published source changed, so no changeset file is added.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on both paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- ESLint, narrowed run: the two changed files with `lint:root`'s own ignore patterns, `--format json`, gave 2 results. The test file has 0 errors and 0 warnings. `.github/labeler.yml` is "File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied", so it sits outside ESLint's population. The narrowing leaves nothing out: `eslint.config.js` extends `tseslint.configs.recommended` (not a type-checked preset) and sets no `parserOptions` or `projectService`, and no rule under `eslint-rules/` reads files. So this diff cannot change a lint result on an untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's second direction, a pin that every top-level tree draws a label, is not taken here. The card says that population needs a decision, and the new assertion covers one tree only.
- The "Auto-Labeler" section of `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md` lists what the coverage test fails on: the two permissions and an unlabelled `packages/` directory. That list is still true but now incomplete, since it does not mention the new docs-tree assertion. The file is outside this card's file surface, so it is not edited here, and no other PR or person is set to pick it up.
- The strip half was read from upstream source, not re-measured live. objectui#10011 carries `documentation` today (read over REST). Whether a `synchronize` run happened after that label was hung was not measured.
